'''Michael C. Neale''' (born 10 March 1958)<ref name=cv>{{Cite web |url=https://independent.academia.edu/NealeMichael/CurriculumVitae |title=Michael Neale Curriculum Vitae |website=academia.edu |language=en |access-date=2018-07-09}}</ref> is a British behavior geneticist and professor at the [[Virginia Institute for Psychiatric and Behavioral Genetics]] at [[Virginia Commonwealth University]]. He is known for his research in the field of [[psychiatric genetics]], which aims to determine the roles of genetic and environmental factors in [[psychiatric disorder]]s and [[substance abuse]]. He is estimated to have mentored over 2,000 students in his field.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://vipbg.vcu.edu/michael-neale-recipient-of-vcu-distinguished-scholarship-award/ |title=Michael Neale, Ph.D. Recipient of VCU Distinguished Scholarship Award  |date=2017-08-25 |website=Virginia Institute for Psychiatric and Behavioral Genetics |language=en-US |access-date=2018-07-09}}</ref> He was president of the [[Behavior Genetics Association]] from 2009 to 2010.<ref name=cv/>
